Change only the viewpoint and stance into a true horizontal RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE: head, muzzle, chest, pelvis and both feet face the unseen opponent on the RIGHT. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor plane, cast shadow, text, frame, watermark, outline, glow or colored fringe. Orthographic horizontal camera at waist level; no frontal chest, no looking at viewer, no top-down perspective. Natural grounded guard with knees lightly flexed, front and back feet separated horizontally on the same baseline; revolver held forward at lower chest level toward the offscreen right opponent, other hand close to the wrist in a plausible ready posture, without firing. Whole gun and barrel, cap, hands, both shoes fully inside the frame with at least 8 percent transparent margin on all sides. One static idle, exactly one adult character and one weapon, no action effects, muzzle flash, blood, enemy or floor. High-detail restrained realistic painted 2D sprite matching the existing artwork. Genuine transparent RGBA background with clean alpha contours, no black or grey backdrop, no cast shadow, glow, outline, text, watermark or selection-card framing. Portrait high-resolution image; preserve all costume details and do not replace the face/outfit with the remake version.

No backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow, colored outline, effects, opponent, text or watermark. High resolution single static frame, no montage.

Use case: identity-preserve. Preserve the lean black/dark charcoal canine body, long narrow neck and muzzle, muscular shoulders, tucked belly, four slender bent canine legs with broad dark paws and small pale claws, stiff short-to-medium tapered tail, and the visibly frayed dirty gray-beige cloth strips winding across its muzzle, neck, back, ribcage and tail as shown. One neck and one elongated canine head with a split-mouth silhouette, never two separately branching heads. Use a neutral alert standing pose at a front-right THREE-QUARTER angle suitable for a roster selection image, all four legs and paws countable and contained, tail complete. Head slightly lowered and mouth only modestly open enough to match the tooth line in the reference. No added eyes, ears, horns, spikes, exposed organs, effects, collar or equipment beyond what the screenshot shows. Match the charcoal and desaturated warm gray palette, worn textile texture, understated natural shading, and crisp realistic hand-painted 2D game asset finish. Whole dog including nose, paws, tail and cloth ends safely within the canvas with at least 10 percent transparent padding. Landscape composition for the complete horizontal body. Exactly one isolated subject, no floor plane or shadow, background scenery, text, UI, crosshairs, frame, glow, colored fringe, duplicate pose or montage. Do not reproduce the gameplay screenshot background. This is a high-detail reconstruction candidate guided by the visible source, not an invented monster.
